question.problem: The lamina $D=\{(x,y)\,:\,1\le y\le 3,\,1\le x\le {e}^{y}\}$ has the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)=\frac{1}{xy}.$ Find the moment of the lamina about the $x$-axis.
question.worked_solution:
The moment of a lamina $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)$ about the $x$-axis is given by

$$
{M}_{x}={∬}_{D}y\,\lambda (x,y)\,\text{d}A.
$$

In our case, $D$ is represented as a type II plane region and $\lambda (x,y)=\frac{1}{xy}.$ 

Therefore, the moment is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{x} & ={∬}_{D}y\cdot \frac{1}{xy}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{3}{\int }_{1}^{{e}^{y}}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{3}[\operatorname{ln}⁡x]_{x=1}^{x={e}^{y}}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{3}y\,\text{d}y \\  & ={[\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}]}_{y=1}^{y=3} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(9-1) \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$
